name: script to start the timesheet as soon as task is marked as working
script:
def sync_task_timer(doc):

    if doc.is_new():
        return

    if not frappe.db.exists("Activity Type", "Task Work"):
        frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "Activity Type",
            "activity_type": "Task Work",
            "billable": 0,
            "costing_rate": 0.0
        }).insert(ignore_permissions=True)

    if not frappe.get_meta("Task").has_field("custom_active_timesheet"):
        if not frappe.db.exists("Custom Field", "Task-custom_active_timesheet"):
            frappe.get_doc({
                "doctype": "Custom Field",
                "dt": "Task",
                "fieldname": "custom_active_timesheet",
                "label": "Active Timesheet",
                "fieldtype": "Link",
                "options": "Timesheet",
                "insert_after": "status",
                "read_only": 1,
                "no_copy": 1
            }).insert(ignore_permissions=True)

    if not doc.has_value_changed("status"):
        return

    assigned_users_raw = frappe.db.get_value("Task", doc.name, "_assign")
    assigned_users = json.loads(assigned_users_raw) if assigned_users_raw else []
    employee_email = assigned_users[0] if assigned_users else doc.owner

    employee = frappe.db.get_value("Employee", {"user_id": employee_email}, "name")
    if not employee:
        frappe.throw(f"No Employee found for user: {employee_email}. Please map Employee to User.")

    company = doc.company or frappe.defaults.get_user_default("Company")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Helper: current active timesheet
    # (Ab doc.custom_active_timesheet — in-memory object — se padhte hain,
    # kyunki isi request ke andar hum ise doc pe hi set kar rahe honge)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def get_active_linked_timesheet():
        active_ts_name = doc.custom_active_timesheet
        if not active_ts_name:
            return None
        if not frappe.db.exists("Timesheet", active_ts_name):
            doc.custom_active_timesheet = None
            return None
        docstatus = frappe.db.get_value("Timesheet", active_ts_name, "docstatus")
        if docstatus != 0:
            doc.custom_active_timesheet = None
            return None
        return frappe.get_doc("Timesheet", active_ts_name)

    # NOTE: dict return kar rahe hain, tuple-unpacking nahi (RestrictedPython
    # sandbox me kabhi-kabhi _unpack_sequence_ guard missing hone se
    # NameError aata h, isliye ye safe tareeka h)
    def close_open_log(ts):
        for log in ts.time_logs:
            if not log.to_time:
                from_time = log.from_time
                to_time = frappe.utils.now()
                hours = round(frappe.utils.time_diff_in_hours(to_time, from_time), 2)
                if hours <= 0:
                    hours = 0.1
                log.to_time = to_time
                log.hours = hours
                ts.total_hours = hours
                ts.save(ignore_permissions=True)
                return {"from_time": from_time, "to_time": to_time, "hours": hours}
        return {"from_time": None, "to_time": None, "hours": None}

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # CASE A: Task -> Working  (Start Timer)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    if doc.status == "Working":
        active_ts = get_active_linked_timesheet()
        if active_ts:
            return

        # Defensive: employee ka koi bhi orphan/open Draft Timesheet
        # dhoondo aur close karo — sirf custom_active_timesheet link pe
        # bharosa mat karo, kyunki wo kabhi out-of-sync ho sakta h
        # (e.g. beech me koi purana error aa jaye to)
        stale_ts_names = frappe.get_all(
            "Timesheet",
            filters={"employee": employee, "docstatus": 0},
            pluck="name"
        )
        for ts_name in stale_ts_names:
            ts_doc = frappe.get_doc("Timesheet", ts_name)
            has_open_log = any(not log.to_time for log in ts_doc.time_logs)
            if has_open_log:
                close_open_log(ts_doc)

        new_ts = frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "Timesheet",
            "employee": employee,
            "company": company,
            "start_date": frappe.utils.today(),
            "end_date": frappe.utils.today(),
            "parent_project": doc.project,
            "status": "Draft",
            "note": f"Auto-Timer for Task: {doc.name}",
            "time_logs": [{
                "activity_type": "Task Work",
                "from_time": frappe.utils.now(),
                "to_time": None,
                "hours": 0.0,
                "project": doc.project,
                "task": doc.name,
                "description": f"Working on: {doc.subject}"
            }]
        })
        new_ts.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

        # ✅ Seedha doc object pe set karo — DB mein hamare validate ke
        # baad khud Frappe ke save() ke through hi persist hoga, isliye
        # overwrite hone ka koi chance nahi
        doc.custom_active_timesheet = new_ts.name

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # CASE B: Task -> Completed  (Stop Timer + Submit + Back-fill)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    elif doc.status == "Completed":
        active_ts = get_active_linked_timesheet()
        if active_ts:
            result = close_open_log(active_ts)
            if result["from_time"]:
                active_ts.reload()
                # active_ts.submit()

                doc.act_start_date = frappe.utils.get_datetime(result["from_time"]).date()
                doc.act_end_date = frappe.utils.get_datetime(result["to_time"]).date()
                doc.actual_time = result["hours"]

        doc.custom_active_timesheet = None

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # CASE C: Koi aur status
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    else:
        active_ts = get_active_linked_timesheet()
        if active_ts:
            close_open_log(active_ts)
        doc.custom_active_timesheet = None


sync_task_timer(doc)

script:
# Server Script for Intern Application (After Save)
# This script creates a Job Applicant when an Intern Application is saved

# Check if Job Applicant already exists to avoid duplicates
existing_job_applicant = frappe.db.exists("Job Applicant", {
    "custom_intern_application": doc.name
})

if not existing_job_applicant:
    try:
        # Map intern application status to job applicant status
        status_mapping = {
            "Applied": "Open",
            "Under Review": "Open", 
            "Shortlisted": "Replied",
            "Interview Scheduled": "Replied",
            "Selected": "Accepted",
            "Rejected": "Rejected",
            "Withdrawn": "Rejected"
        }
        
        # Get the mapped status or default to "Open"
        mapped_status = status_mapping.get(doc.application_status, "Open")
        
        # Map how_did_you_hear to source
        source_mapping = {
            "Company Website": "Website Listing",
            "Job Portal": "Website Listing", 
            "Social Media": "Campaign",
            "University Career Center": "Campus Placement",
            "Referral from Friend/Colleague": "Employee Referral",
            "Professor Recommendation": "Employee Referral",
            "Other": "Website Listing"}
        
        # Get the mapped source
        mapped_source = source_mapping.get(doc.how_did_you_hear, "Other")
        
        # Prepare cover letter text
        cover_letter_parts = []
        if doc.motivation:
            cover_letter_parts.append(f"Motivation: {doc.motivation}")
        if doc.career_goals:
            cover_letter_parts.append(f"Career Goals: {doc.career_goals}")
        if doc.previous_experience:
            cover_letter_parts.append(f"Previous Experience: {doc.previous_experience}")
        if doc.technical_skills:
            cover_letter_parts.append(f"Technical Skills: {doc.technical_skills}")
        if doc.soft_skills:
            cover_letter_parts.append(f"Soft Skills: {doc.soft_skills}")
            
        cover_letter_text = "\n\n".join(cover_letter_parts)
        
        # # Prepare notes
        # notes_parts = []
        # if doc.current_education_level:
        #     notes_parts.append(f"Education: {doc.current_education_level}")
        # if doc.field_of_study:
        #     notes_parts.append(f"Field of Study: {doc.field_of_study}")
        # if doc.institution_name:
        #     notes_parts.append(f"Institution: {doc.institution_name}")
        # if doc.preferred_department:
        #     notes_parts.append(f"Preferred Department: {doc.preferred_department}")
        # if doc.internship_type:
        #     notes_parts.append(f"Internship Type: {doc.internship_type}")
        # if doc.internship_duration:
        #     notes_parts.append(f"Duration: {doc.internship_duration}")
        # if doc.additional_comments:
        #     notes_parts.append(f"Additional Comments: {doc.additional_comments}")
            
        # notes_text = " | ".join(notes_parts)
        
        # Create new Job Applicant with mapped fields
        job_applicant = frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "Job Applicant",
            "applicant_name": doc.full_name,
            "email_id": doc.email,
            "status": mapped_status,
            "job_title": doc.job_title,  # This should link to Job Opening
            "source": mapped_source,
            "source_name": doc.referral_name if doc.how_did_you_hear in ["Referral from Friend/Colleague", "Professor Recommendation"] else None,
            "cover_letter": cover_letter_text,
            "resume_attachment": doc.resume,
            # "notes": notes_text,
            "phone_number": doc.phone_number,
            "country": doc.country,
            "resume_link": doc.portfolio_url,  # Using portfolio URL as resume link
            "custom_intern_application": doc.name  # Link back to intern application
        })
        
        # Insert the Job Applicant
        job_applicant.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
        
        frappe.msgprint(f"Job Applicant {job_applicant.name} created successfully from Intern Application!")
        
        # Optional: Update intern application with reference to created job applicant
        frappe.db.set_value("Intern Application", doc.name, "job_applicant", job_applicant.name)
        
    except Exception as e:
        frappe.log_error(f"Error creating Job Applicant from Intern Application {doc.name}: {str(e)}")
        frappe.throw(f"Failed to create Job Applicant: {str(e)}")
else:
    frappe.msgprint("Job Applicant already exists for this Intern Application.")

name: addition managers
script:
CREATED_BY_TAG = "auto_additional_manager"

# Step 1: Remove old auto-created User Permissions for this employee
old_perms = frappe.get_all(
    "User Permission",
    filters={
        "allow": "Employee",
        "for_value": doc.name,
        "custom_creation_via_additional_manager": 1
    },
    pluck="name"
)

for perm_name in old_perms:
    frappe.delete_doc("User Permission", perm_name, ignore_permissions=True)

# Step 2: Recreate based on current additional_managers table
for row in doc.get("additional_managers", []):
    if not row.manager_user:
        continue

    exists = frappe.db.exists("User Permission", {
        "user": row.manager_user,
        "allow": "Employee",
        "for_value": doc.name
    })

    if not exists:
        perm = frappe.new_doc("User Permission")
        perm.user = row.manager_user
        perm.allow = "Employee"
        perm.for_value = doc.name
        perm.apply_to_all_doctypes = 1
        perm.custom_creation_via_additional_manager = 1
        perm.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

frappe.db.commit()
